item.mng: tegünčilen iregsen dayin-i daruγsan üneger tuγuluγsan burqan qamuγ maγui ǰayaγan-i oγoγata arilγaγči ǰibqulang-tu qaγan-u onol nigen ǰüg neretü
item.coloph: enedkeg-ün ubadini yeke arigun eǰen blam-a de ben dra dev-a-yin ölmei kiged, yeke pandita blam-a yeke boqda manu ka sri ǰnan-a-yin ǰarliq-ača kündülen sonosču čhag ločhava sakyalig-du-un ayaq-γ-a tegimlig čorǰi dpal orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orusiγulbai, edüge basa tai ku erketü kümün-ü eǰen delekei dekin-ü qormusda-yin ǰarliq-iyar samdan sengge töbed-ün kelen-eče mongγolčilaǰu orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orusiγulbai

item.mng: tegünčilen iregsen dayini daruγsan / üneger tuγuluγsan burqan qamuγ maγui jayaγan-i oγoγata arilγaγči jibqulang-tu qaγan-u onol nigen jüg-tür ner-e-tü.
item.coloph: enedkeg-ün ubadini yeke ariγun eǰen lam-a dêu indii-ra deu-a bada / kiged yeke baṇdida lam-a yeke boγda mani ka siri inzan-a-yin ǰarliγ-ača kündülen sonosču čaγ lozau sakyalig-ud-un ayaγ-qa / tegimlig čorǰi ṱpal orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orosiγulbai. edüge basa tari kü erketü kümün-ü eǰen delekei-tekin-ü qormusta-yin / ǰarliγ-iyar samdan sengge töbed-ün kelen-eče mongγolčilaǰu orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orosiγulbai. , .
